purpose: One known near loss, observed candidate seat 1, seed 621456920. Diagnose a realizable delivery or denial at real t289..297. No training or independent win evidence.
root_choice: Using only each pre-action public observation plus that turn's frozen candidate joint orders, select at most one root per family. No branch run, later enemy order, terminal margin or later deposits used to rank these. Tape identifies the close loss retrospectively.
deliver: Own collector load >=20, not at own home, home dist <= available turns, recorded first step does not reduce shortest distance. Alternative steps must reduce distance, must have no allied reservation or enemy base and no enemy collector currently able to reach and tie/beat it at the landing. Rank by descending exposed cargo, smaller available slack, earlier t, unit ID, direction index. Prefer no hostile tree then stable direction among a unit's shortest choices.
deny: Enemy collector load >=40, d 2..5 to either own bank and able to arrive by horizon. Our strictly lighter collector can reach a possible next shortest-path nonbase landing of that enemy simultaneously in zero or one move. Exclude allied reservations and other reachable enemy collectors with load <= ours. Logged command must not already occupy that landing. Rank by enemy cargo, number of shortest next cells (fewer better), earlier t, own cargo then UID and direction. Exclude same root/worker as delivery case. No actual enemy action consulted.
comparisons: For each selected case, test archived root command and one registered replacement. The opponent simultaneous root command is held common as actually recorded; both agents recompute all future actions. The opponent belief history uses real observations and executed opponent orders up to the root. Four distinct fresh MT19937 states independent of final cash, paired within each case, same cost baseline between arms. A timer-budget search may differ between arms even with coupled draws. Retain every outcome, including negative/no effect and one-arm losses; no promotion claims.
evidence: Official interpreter to end, both branches' initial/step/final cash, deliveries, tree income, target positions, full command tapes, separate unchanged-arm replicate dispersion and score/utility changes.
